subject: ENGLISH 2
description: ICSE Class 10 English Literature: Treasure Chest Short Stories

questions.question: In Stephen Leacock's 'With the Photographer', why was the narrator deeply offended by the finished photograph?
options: It was too dark and blurry
The photographer had retouched his eyes, eyebrows, and mouth beyond recognition
It took three weeks to develop
The cost was three times the agreed price
questions.explanation: The photographer altered the narrator's face using delphide and process adjustments, stripping away his natural features.

questions.question: In 'With the Photographer', what did the photographer do to the narrator's ears in the proof?
options: He planned to strike them out completely and replace them with new ears
questions.explanation: The photographer said: 'I don't like the ears... I can strike them out, and put them in with a new process.'

questions.question: In William Sleator's 'The Elevator', why does twelve-year-old Martin dislike the elevator in his new apartment building?
options: It was noisy and shook violently
It was small, claustrophobic, poorly lit, and the fat lady with eerie green eyes cornered him
questions.explanation: Martin feared the small elevator's dirty green walls and the eerie, obese woman who stared unblinkingly at him.

questions.question: In 'The Elevator', what happened when Martin tried taking the stairs instead of the elevator?
options: He twisted his ankle on the dark stairs and was forced back onto crutches
His father forbade him from using the stairs
questions.explanation: Running down the stairs in terror, Martin fell and fractured his leg, forcing him back into the elevator with crutches.

questions.question: In Ama Ata Aidoo's 'The Girl Who Can', what physical feature of Adjoa did her grandmother Nana constantly criticize?
options: Her long, thin legs with missing calves
questions.explanation: Nana was obsessed with Adjoa's thin legs, lamenting that without solid calves, she could never support hips to bear children.

questions.question: In 'The Girl Who Can', what achievement finally made Nana proud of Adjoa's legs?
options: She passed her high school exams
She was selected to represent the junior school in district athletics and won the cup
questions.explanation: Adjoa won every running race at the district sports meet, leading Nana to carry the shiny trophy cup on her back.

questions.question: In Ray Bradbury's 'The Pedestrian', why was Leonard Mead arrested by the automated police car in AD 2053?
options: He was walking alone at night instead of watching television indoors like everyone else
He spoke disrespectfully to the police
questions.explanation: In Bradbury's dystopian society, walking at night for fresh air was considered an abnormal 'regressive tendency'.

questions.question: In 'The Pedestrian', what destination did the automated police cruiser enter for Leonard Mead?
options: The Psychiatric Center for Research on Regressive Tendencies
questions.explanation: The voice in the automated car announced he was being taken to the Psychiatric Center for Research on Regressive Tendencies.

questions.question: In Alphonse Daudet's 'The Last Lesson', what order had come from Berlin regarding the schools of Alsace and Lorraine?
options: To teach only German instead of French
To close down all schools permanently
To pay a heavy war tax
questions.explanation: The order from Berlin mandated that German alone would be taught in the schools of Alsace and Lorraine.

questions.question: In 'The Last Lesson', what did M. Hamel write in huge letters on the blackboard before dismissing the class?
questions.explanation: Choked with emotion at the church bell, M. Hamel took a piece of chalk and wrote: 'Vive la France!' (Long Live France!).
